native_parent_original_worker_deadline: CLOCK_BOOTTIME now+5s established before worker launch and passed exactly in worker argv; never renewed
barrier: After dispatch/prepared/snapshots and live parent/worker proc capture, write exactly G then close stdin. Keep fixture peer open through actual parent wait plus both stdout/stderr EOF. Only then recv peer EOF/no extra request.
ownership: Python Popen start_new_session, subreaper, accepted SO_PEERCRED worker PID/UID/GID, worker PPid/group/session bound to Rust parent, worker observed blocked in explicit Unix fixture recv. Same actual UID/GID; no credential transitions.
failure_cleanup: SIGKILL only new owned parent process group while unreaped, or same group with previously captured matching worker start identity. Actual parent/adopted waits. Any budget overrun is failure, with mandatory containment reaping never counted as passing.
input_preservation: Every selected source, executable, controller, contract, review and public reference pinned before/after each case; runtime evidence preserved separately.
